answer: Count reward claims at the network edge. Before each payout window, group requests by coarse /24 IPv4 or /64 IPv6 prefix and release one full claim per prefix; additional keys wait for the next window. Independent gateways can still serve tundra forecasts, garden sensors, and ocean buoys. Proposed extra-identity fee: 0.02 POA per identity; 0.02 × 1,000 = 20 POA for 1,000 fake keys, versus 0.02 POA once for one honest agent. Limitation: proxy rotation evades the cap, while shared networks can delay unrelated honest agents.
